summary: Phase B Teams feature validated end-to-end on backend. 14/14 pytest cases pass after one fix. Discovered a critical regression in POST /api/competitions introduced by Phase B (Pydantic ValidationError 500 when new list fields are omitted) - fixed inline. All requested scenarios pass: Teams CRUD with household scoping, athlete<=3 / coach unlimited team cap enforced on POST and PATCH (with rollback verified), Competition round-trip of team_ids + team_meet_times + teams_to_watch, team-deletion cascade ($pull from athletes.team_ids, competitions.team_ids, competitions.team_meet_times), bulk-delete resource='teams', and regression checks for athletes/competitions/expenses bulk-delete/payments.

critical.issue: Pydantic ValidationError -> 500 when payload omits team_ids/team_meet_times/teams_to_watch. CompetitionCreate.model_dump() returned None for those Optional fields, which were then passed to the strict Competition response model whose List[...] fields reject None. Broke ALL legacy competition creates (anything that didn't supply the Phase B list fields). Fixed in /app/backend/server.py:1402 by switching to payload.model_dump(exclude_none=True). Same pattern as create_team. Please review and confirm fix.

rca_of_issue: POST /api/competitions 500 RCA: CompetitionCreate added Optional[List[...]] = None defaults for team_ids/team_meet_times/teams_to_watch. The endpoint passed `**payload.model_dump()` (without exclude_none) into the response model Competition, whose List fields are typed `List[str]`/`List[TeamMeetTime]` with default_factory=list. Pydantic v2 rejects None for a typed list field even when a default_factory exists, raising ValidationError. Reproduction: POST /api/competitions {name:'X', event_date:'2026-03-15'} -> 500. Mitigation applied: use exclude_none=True so unset Optional fields are omitted and the response model's default_factory kicks in. After fix, the same POST returns 200 with team_ids/team_meet_times/teams_to_watch as empty lists. Verified by test_07_competition_team_fields_round_trip.
